title: Senior Network Architect
description: Lead the design and implementation of DoD transport network architectures, with primary focus on DISN circuit engineering, MPLS/VPLS topology, and NIPRNet/SIPRNet segmentation. This role owns the full network design lifecycle from requirements analysis through acceptance testing and as-built documentation.
requirements: CCNP or CCIE (R&S or SP track)
Active TS clearance — SCI eligible preferred

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description: Own the cybersecurity compliance posture for active federal programs. This role executes DoD RMF Authorization-to-Operate packages, drives CMMC Level 2 assessments, and implements NIST SP 800-171 controls across multi-system environments. You will work directly with the PM and CO to maintain ATO status under live government contracts.

title: SaaS Technical Writer
description: Create best-in-class technical documentation, user guides, and proposal content for the Harpy Talon PDLC platform. This role bridges the gap between complex federal acquisition processes and clear, evaluator-ready language. Ideal candidate has hands-on federal proposal writing experience and an appreciation for how government source selection actually works.
